# Command reference

Every operation in this area, as a `metorial-admin` CLI command and as a tool on the Metorial admin MCP server (`mcp.metorial.com/mcp`). API version: `mt_2026_01_01_magnetar`. 17 CLI commands, 17 MCP tools.

- **CLI**: prefix with `metorial-admin`. Run `metorial-admin <command> --help` for every flag. Write commands also accept `--body` or `--body-file` with a JSON object.
- **MCP tool**: pass inputs in snake_case (`<provider-id>` → `provider_id`). Instance-scoped tools also accept an optional `instance_id`.
- **Effect**: `read` changes nothing; `write` creates or changes something; `destructive` deletes, revokes, archives, or runs code. Confirm destructive actions with the user first.
- **—** in a column means that interface has no equivalent. Use the alternative named in the summary, or call the API path with `metorial-admin fetch` / the `call_endpoint` tool.

## custom-providers

| CLI command | MCP tool | Effect | Summary | Required inputs | API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `custom-providers archive <custom-provider-id>` | `custom_providers_archive` | destructive | Archive custom provider | <custom-provider-id> | `POST /custom-providers/:customProviderId/archive` |
| `custom-providers create` | `custom_providers_create` | write | Create custom provider | --name | `POST /custom-providers` |
| `custom-providers get <custom-provider-id>` | `custom_providers_get` | read | Get custom provider | <custom-provider-id> | `GET /custom-providers/:customProviderId` |
| `custom-providers list` | `custom_providers_list` | read | List custom providers |  | `GET /custom-providers` |
| `custom-providers update <custom-provider-id>` | `custom_providers_update` | write | Update custom provider | <custom-provider-id> | `PATCH /custom-providers/:customProviderId` |
